meta.note: public statistics are evaluation-side; do not train on mmbu-public

rules.applies: modality in ['light microscopy', 'fluorescence microscopy', 'electron microscopy', 'digital pathology']
all non-microscopy rows except modality 'clinical photography'; microscopy rows only sometimes (see by_modality)
rules.evidence: non-microscopy rows without body part: 31 (all 'clinical photography' modality)

rules.applies: every microscopy row has body_part or stain or both
rules.evidence: both 294, body-part only 302, stain only 278, neither 0

rules.applies: always asked; value 'human' for clinical modalities (see implication rules)

steps: ast.literal_eval the cell (it is a python-list string)
for each list item split on /\s*,\s*/ (packed items like 'gastroenterology, radiology')
alias map: otorhinolaryngology and 'otolaryngology (ent)' -> otolaryngology; infectious diseases -> infectious disease; gynecology -> obstetrics and gynecology
dedupe; treat as an UNORDERED set (the same pair appears in both orders)
never split on ' and ' (only 'obstetrics and gynecology' contains it)

body_part_parsing.alias: lungs -> lung; male genitournary system -> male genitourinary system (see vocab.py)

training_rules.rule: submodality hard and exactly one candidate modality is legal for it
{digital pathology, light microscopy} candidates -> light microscopy (public: 92% of WSI, 96% of brightfield rows are LM)
{laparoscopy, white-light endoscopy} -> laparoscopy (the specific term)
{colonoscopy|gastroscopy, white-light endoscopy} -> white-light endoscopy (public: 163 WLE vs 5 colonoscopy rows)
strong submodality implies body part (fundus/OCT/OCTA/FA -> eye, dermoscopy -> skin, mammography -> breast, chest x-ray -> chest, colposcopy -> cervix)
laparoscopy -> abdomen when registry says 'not applicable' or lists only abdominal organs (public: 93% abdomen family)
prune modifiers: drop blood vessels/arteries when a region is listed; head subset of brain for MRI/CT
remaining candidates all in one anatomical family -> train the family head hard, atom head partial-label
UNRESOLVED: candidates span several families (true multi-region dataset; needs per-image metadata)
UNRESOLVED: masked (registry 'not applicable'/'multiple', or >4 regions across several families)
masked only because >4 regions were listed, all in one family (galar, rhode-island-vce: GI tract) -> family-hard
non-microscopy modality: stain not asked -> mask (already done by select_datasets.py)
cryo-ET or darkfield submodality -> 'unstained' (public: 15/15 rows)
synthetic fluorescence -> stain 'synthetic' (public: 38/38 rows; currently dropped by canon_stain)
submodality for which MMBU never asks stain (phase contrast, contrast, confocal, differential, multiphoton): mask confirmed
UNRESOLVED: stained modality, registry has no stain (registry text mining finds a stain keyword in only 4/35)
WARN: registry lists a stain for a submodality MMBU never asks stain for (harmless, but weight down)
drop non-species tokens (cell line, phantom, cells) when exactly one species is listed
clinical (non-microscopy-lab) modality and 'human' among candidates -> human (public: >=96% human)
submodality = synthetic fluorescence microscopy -> specimen 'synthetic' (public: 38/38)
{bacteria, e. coli}: nested, keep as family
UNRESOLVED candidates (multi-species datasets)
SOFT: clinical modality with registry specimen 'unknown' -> human (not applied automatically)
UNRESOLVED masked ('mixed', plankton, unknown)
radiologic modality: drop 'radiology' when a specialty is present (registry 95-100% vs public 10-49%); also brings the 3 four-domain datasets under the public cap of 3
radiology is the only registry domain: keep

modality.head: softmax
modality.constraint: none; root of the decode order

body_part.classes: public atoms (66 after aliases) + registry atoms with >=3 datasets; plus a 14-way family head
body_part.type: multi-label atoms (BCE) + single family; partial-label loss for candidates
body_part.applicable: mask when dataset label is masked; at inference ask only when requested

stain.mask: all non-microscopy images and NO_STAIN submodalities

specimen.mask: non-answers (x-ray images, unidentified, biological specimen, mixed)

domain.decode: top-1 always, add 2nd/3rd only if p>=tau
domain.train_fix: drop radiology when another specialty present
